def control(obs):
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    rear = obs.get('rig', {}).get('trailer_rear', [0.0, 0.0])
    y = rear[1] if len(rear) > 1 else 0.0
    steer = 2.0 * h + 6.0 * y
    steer = max(-30.0, min(30.0, steer))
    return (steer, -0.8, 170)
